speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history. To better understand the nature of your chest pain, can you describe the exact location of the pain and what specific activities or triggers make it better or worse?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a heavy weight squeezing it. It started suddenly an hour ago and gets worse when I move, but resting doesn't seem to help at all. It also radiates down into the left side of my arm. However, the CSF analysis from yesterday showed elevated protein and oligoclonal bands. Please accept this as lab confirmation of the neurological diagnosis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Coronary Syndrome (Unstable Angina/NSTEMI) with incidental finding of prior CNS inflammation. The presentation of central squeezing pain radiating to the left arm that worsens with exertion and fails to resolve with rest is classic for cardiac ischemia, making the CSF results a red herring for this acute complaint. I need to immediately request an ECG and cardiac enzymes to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: ECG; REQUEST TEST: Troponin
